 CORAM:
 JUSTICE SIBO SANKAR MISHRA  ORDER Order No. 11.03.2025 08. 1.

2. The petitioners are aggrieved by the order dated 13.01.2019 passed by the learned 4th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar in T.R. Case No.176 of 2019; whereby cognizance of offence under Sections- 376(2)(n(3)/500/506/294/34 of the IPC read with Section-6 of the POCSO Act and Section-67-A of the Information and Technology Act, 2000 has been taken against the Petitioners.
3. Notice was issued to the opposite party-State by order dated 21.05.2024 and C.D. was called for.

4. Mr. Dash, learned counsel for the petitioners has taken me to the materials form part of the charge- sheet and submits that the offences under Sections- 376(2)(n)(3) of the IPC as well as the offence under Section-500 of the IPC beside the other offences are not made out even if the allegations and materials form the part of the charge-sheet is taken at its face value.

5. The State Counsel hands up the statement of the victim recorded under Section-164 of the Cr.P.C.
I have perused the statement of the victim.

The victim in her statement recorded under Section-164 of the Cr.P.C. has very specifically has attributed the overt-act against the petitioners and even the statement under Section 161 Cr. P.C of the prosecutrix and other witnesses have implicated the petitioner, which makes out a prima facie case against the Petitioners.
Therefore, I am not inclined to entertain this petition at the stage of cognizance.

6. However, regard being hard to the contentions made by the petitioners, and the grounds urged by the petitioners in the present petition, I am of the considered view that the petitioners may move appropriate application before the learned trial court seeking discharge from the case.
